branded.why: A one-off or short-lived product that left no mark on how people eat.

about.text: An experimental ice cream made from breast milk, offered for tasting at Kjörís's Ísdagurinn (Ice Day) in Hveragerði as one of several new flavours. It is not said to have gone on sale.

sources.text: Ice Day product development, with breast-milk ice cream among the tasted flavours.
